newsitem.title: UK: Wakebourne in buyout talks, trade suspended.
newsitem.headline: Wakebourne in buyout talks, trade suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of British business systems firm Wakebourne Plc was suspended on Monday as the company announced it was in advanced discussions that could lead to an offer for the company.
"The directors are in advanced discussions which may lead to an offer for the whole of the issued and to be issued share capital of the company," Wakebourne said in a statement.
The company said the offer, if made, would be at a price substantially below Wakebourne's current share price and was dependent on agreement with its banker, the Bank of Scotland .
The company' share price was last quoted at 10 1/2p on Friday. The company's last reported full-year results showed a pre-tax loss of 3.38 million stg for the year to December, 1995.
